title: At Home and with Family
ringkas: Meminta tolong, berbagi tugas, dan merencanakan akhir pekan
goals: membalas percakapan **di rumah dan bersama keluarga**
membahas **rencana akhir pekan** dan makan malam

lesson.text: Percakapan di rumah singkat dan hangat: meminta tolong, berbagi tugas, dan membuat rencana. Balaslah dengan kalimat pendek yang jelas.

lines.en: Dina, could you help me in the kitchen?
lines.id: Dina, bisa membantu Ibu di dapur?

lines.en: OK. Shall I set the table too?
lines.id: Baik. Perlu aku menata meja juga?

lesson.title: Cara berlatih
lesson.text: Latihan di rumah: ucapkan balasan dalam bahasa Inggris saat anggota keluarga bertanya (dalam hati juga boleh). Cara ini membangun kebiasaan.

items: Meminta tolong: [[Could you help me with ...?]]

practice.q: Could you help me clean the living room?
turns: Could you help me clean the living room?
answers: Of course. Where should I start?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Sure, I'll help you.  atau  Of course. Where should I start?  atau  OK, no problem.

practice.scene: Ibu minta tolong, tetapi kamu sedang belajar.
answers: In ten minutes, please. I'm doing homework.
Can I do it later? I'm studying.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Just a moment, I'm studying.  atau  In ten minutes, please. I'm doing homework.  atau  Can I do it later? I'm studying.

answers: Thanks, Mom. What do we have?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Great! What are we having?  atau  Coming! What's for dinner?  atau  Thanks, Mom. What do we have?

practice.q: What shall we do this weekend?
turns: What shall we do this weekend?
answers: How about going to the beach?
Can we go to the beach?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: How about going to the beach?  atau  Let's go to the beach.  atau  Can we go to the beach?

answers: Sure. What do you need it for?
OK, but give it back soon.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Sure. What do you need it for?  atau  Of course. Here you are.  atau  OK, but give it back soon.

practice.scene: Adik meminjam ponselmu, kamu belum bisa.
answers: I'm sorry, I need it right now.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Sorry, I'm using it now.  atau  I'm sorry, I need it right now.  atau  Not now, please.

answers: Not yet. I'll finish it soon.
No, not yet. I need an hour.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Not yet. I'll finish it soon.  atau  No, not yet. I need an hour.  atau  Almost. I'll finish after dinner.

answers: How many eggs do you need?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: How many eggs do you need?  atau  How many should I buy?  atau  Sure. How many?

answers: Good! I like my English class.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: School is fine, Grandma.  atau  It's going well, thank you.  atau  Good! I like my English class.

answers: I'm sorry. The bus was late because of the rain.
I waited for the rain to stop.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Sorry, it was raining.  atau  I'm sorry. The bus was late because of the rain.  atau  I waited for the rain to stop.

practice.q: I can drive you to school.
turns: I can drive you to school.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Thank you, Dad.  atau  That would be great, thanks.  atau  Thanks! That's very kind.

answers: A little. What do we have?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: A little. What do we have?  atau  Yes, I'm a bit hungry.  atau  Yes, I am.

practice.q: Do you want to watch a film tonight?
turns: Do you want to watch a film tonight?
answers: OK, let's watch it after dinner.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Yes, good idea!  atau  Sure, which film?  atau  OK, let's watch it after dinner.

practice.q: What time will you be home?
turns: What time will you be home?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I'll be home at six.  atau  Around six o'clock.  atau  At six, Mom.

practice.q: Pilih balasan yang sopan untuk "Could you help me?"
practice.exp: Menyetujui. Jawaban yang tepat: **Sure, no problem.**

practice.q: Pilih ungkapan untuk menunda dengan sopan:
practice.exp: Menunda. Jawaban yang tepat: **Just a moment, please.**

practice.q: Pilih ungkapan untuk menolak dengan sopan:
options: I'm sorry, I can't right now.
practice.exp: Menolak. Jawaban yang tepat: **I'm sorry, I can't right now.**

practice.q: Pilih balasan yang wajar untuk "Dinner is ready!"
options: Thank you for the nice flowers.
practice.exp: Menanggapi. Jawaban yang tepat: **Coming!**

options: How about going to the park?
practice.exp: Ajakan. Jawaban yang tepat: **How about going to the park?**
Menawarkan. Jawaban yang tepat: **Shall I help you?**
